title: Local injectivity of a small-valued universal fppf sheafification unit
statement: Fix a universe u and a scheme S [def-pc-scheme]. Let P be a Type u-valued presheaf on the big fppf site over S [def-pc-fppf-site], F a Type u-valued sheaf, and η : P → F a natural transformation such that composition with η bijects morphisms F → G with morphisms P → G for every Type u-valued sheaf G [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then η is locally injective: two sections with equal images agree on a covering sieve.

source.place: Tags 00WB and 00WK, local representability of sheafification; size refinement using Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/FiniteType.lean, essentiallySmall_costructuredArrow_Spec

proof.text: Take the usual Type (u+1)-valued sheafification of ULift(P). Its unit is locally surjective and locally injective by the Mathlib plus-construction theorem. By [lem-trf-fppf-small-local-representatives], each section type is u-small. Shrink these types functorially; the natural equivalences preserve the sheaf property and give a small-valued unit θ. By the specified universal property obtain l : F → Q with η followed by l equal to θ. Equal images under η have equal images under θ, so local injectivity of the standard unit yields local equality of the original sections. ULift injectivity removes the lift.

theorem fppf_universal_unit_locally_injective {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (F : Sheaf (fppfTopology.over S) (Type u))
    (η : P ⟶ F.obj)
    (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (fppfTopology.over S) (Type u),
      Function.Bijective (fun g : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ g)) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (fppfTopology.over S) η
